from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.adjustments import outage_refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly import audit

T0 = datetime(2026,10,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)

def pay(amount="80.00", status="captured"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amount),status=status,created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# partial refund
p = pay(); r = outage_refund(p, Decimal("8.00"), T0)
print("partial", p.refunded_amount, p.status, r is p)

# full refund -> status refunded
p = pay("10.00"); outage_refund(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0)
print("full", p.refunded_amount, p.status)

# multiple partials
p = pay("10.00"); outage_refund(p, Decimal("4.00"), T0); outage_refund(p, Decimal("6.00"), T0)
print("multi", p.refunded_amount, p.status)

# errors
for desc, fn in [
    ("non-positive", lambda: outage_refund(pay(), Decimal("0"), T0)),
    ("negative", lambda: outage_refund(pay(), Decimal("-1"), T0)),
    ("exceeds", lambda: outage_refund(pay("10.00"), Decimal("10.01"), T0)),
    ("not captured", lambda: outage_refund(pay(status="authorized"), Decimal("1"), T0)),
]:
    try:
        fn(); print("FAIL", desc)
    except BillingError as e:
        print("ok", desc, e.code)

# approval threshold
p = pay("2000.00")
try:
    outage_refund(p, Decimal("1500.00"), T0)
    print("FAIL approval")
except BillingError as e:
    print("ok approval", e.code)
p2 = pay("2000.00")
outage_refund(p2, Decimal("1500.00"), T0, approved_by="mgr")
print("approved", p2.refunded_amount)

# idempotency
audit.clear()
p = pay("10.00")
r1 = outage_refund(p, Decimal("5.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k")
r2 = outage_refund(p, Decimal("5.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k")
print("idempotent", r1 is r2 is p, p.refunded_amount, len(audit.events("outage_refund")))
EOF"}
